plan: This is a second-price auction (I win and pay the second-highest bid if I have the highest bid). In such auctions, bidding your true value is the dominant strategy - it maximizes expected profit regardless of others' strategies. Since my payment depends on others' bids, not my own bid amount (given I win), there's no incentive to shade my bid up or down. I'll bid exactly my value of $14.

This is a second-price (Vickrey-style) auction where the winner pays the second-highest bid, not their own bid. In such auctions, bidding your true value is the dominant strategy—it maximizes expected profit regardless of others' bids. Bidding higher than my value risks paying more than the item is worth to me; bidding lower risks losing profitable opportunities. Since my value is $34, I will bid exactly $34.
